gate.question: Does any selected ordinary L2 sequencer admit the complete deterministic 80-210 KiB transaction range while preserving a reproducible fee and verifier evidence path?
gate.reason: Every selected ordinary sequencer source-proven byte limit rejects the generated 210 KiB signed transactions; no selected network supports the complete range.

decision: Do not select an ordinary direct-sequencer route for an unchunked 210 KiB witness. Any chunked or non-ordinary route requires a separate design and faithful local reproduction.
prohibitions: Do not describe projected admission as a receipt.
Do not describe no-op calldata gas as verifier execution.
Do not describe any synthetic fee as live.
Do not claim PQTC measurement without the exact verifier receipt.
